item.title: Who was Osman Hadi? Why has his murder triggered anti-India sentiments?
item.description: The killing of Sharif Osman Hadi, a key figure in Bangladesh’s 2024 student uprising, has further strained fragile India-Bangladesh ties, triggering a surge of anti-India sentiment after his death in Singapore.

item.title: ED questions Jai Anmol Ambani in Yes Bank probe; Delhi HC scraps Union Bank fraud tag
item.description: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) on Friday questioned Jai Anmol Ambani, son of industrialist Anil Ambani, in Delhi as part of a money laundering investigation linked to an alleged bank loan fraud involving Yes Bank, according to official sources.
